content.tagline: Korean professional skincare brand born in an aesthetic spa
content.descriptor: ACFIT and its V-SANG BETA-G line: care built around cooling, the skin barrier and microbiome balance, for treatment rooms and home care
about: According to its own presentation, ACFIT is a professional skincare brand that originated at V-Medi Spa, an aesthetic centre in Bupyeong, Incheon. The company says its products were developed and refined in day-to-day spa practice before being offered to other professionals.

ACFIT describes its approach in three steps: cool the skin, restore the skin barrier, balance the microbiome. The name of the signature V-SANG line comes from the Korean word 비상 (bisang, “emergency”); “Beta-G” stands for β-glucan, which the company names as a shared ingredient of its core formulas.

The company states that ACFIT is used at about 250 aesthetic and skincare centres in Korea and that the current range has 14 products: 3 for professional use only and 11 for both treatments and home care. These are the company’s own figures; Teranova has not verified them independently.
facts: Origin: V-Medi Spa, Incheon — per the company, the salon has 27 years of practice
Founder and CEO of V-Medi Spa: Hyun-joo Lee
The brand is used by about 250 aesthetic and dermatology centers in Korea
14 products in the V-SANG BETA-G line: 3 professional-only, 11 for treatments and home care
CPNP · SCPN · MoCRA — confirmed for 13 of the 14 products; ACFIT Beta-G Lacto Sun Cream certification is in process
channels: Distributors serving aesthetic and skincare centres
Aesthetic and skincare centres and clinics

tech.name: Product-mixing protocol

catalog_notes: Gentle cleansing with beta-glucan and panthenol, no tight feeling; suitable for sensitive skin.
Hydrating soothing toner: moisture, tone brightening and anti-aging care from within.
Gel with a patented cooling complex — emergency calming for irritation; doubles as a sleeping mask.
Premium moisturizing cream with Sparassis crispa extract, aloe vera and Houttuynia cordata; for tired, dull skin.
Niacinamide and adenosine for brightening and smoothing fine lines; a microbiome-support system for healthy skin.
Hydrating elasticity booster: nourishes dry skin, leaves a plump, smooth texture.
Barrier-strengthening, microbiome-balancing ampoule; used as a spot treatment for irritation.
Soothing oil with azulene, tocopherol, sunflower seed oil and squalane; blends with other products in the line.
Fast-acting soothing and hydrating sheet mask on a natural base.
Clay mask with kaolin and bentonite, a cooling complex and 5 Centella extracts, for clear skin.
Sunscreen with dual UV filters, niacinamide and adenosine; a light, fresh texture. Certification is in process.
Professional intensive-soothing ampoule for problem skin; for MTS/MCS/SDM protocols.
Professional freeze-dried ampoule with vitamin C, Centella, hyaluronic acid and collagen.
Professional peeling treatment to refine skin texture; physical peel, no brush, applied with gloved hands.
